newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Intl H1 net up 325 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Intl H1 net up 325 pct.

text.p: Retailer Shenzhen International Enterprise Co Ltd said on Monday its net profits in the first half of 1996 surged 325 percent over the same perod last year to 30.84 million yuan.
In an interim report published in the Shenzhen Securities Times, the firm said per-share earnings surged to 0.23 yuan from 0.087 yuan last year under Chinese accounting standards.
Main operating income, however, reached only 105.55 million yuan against 141.72 million yuan in first half 1995, it said.

A company spokesman said the first-half profits for 1996 largely stemmed from the sale of its 50 percent-owned 81,000-sq-metre Guoqi Building, an office complex located in the centre of Shenzhen in southern China.
The project was completed at the end of last year, the spokesman noted.

Shenzhen International has forecast net earnings of 54.32 million yuan for the full year under Chinese accounting standards, compared with 40.83 million yuan in 1995 and 26.49 million yuan a year earlier, according to the spokesman.
